business: ILLUSTRUS — site-uri și automatizări pentru consultanți în fonduri europene
target: the owner of a small consulting firm in Romania (Bihor/Oradea or Bucharest) that writes and manages EU and national grant projects for SMEs and farmers; the income figure above is your FIRM's annual revenue in EUR, not your salary

segments.name: Solo consultant / PFA-style firm, 1-2 people, 5-15 clients a year
Small consulting firm, 3-8 people, 20-50 active clients
Established firm, 8-15 people, 50+ clients, several programmes

behaviours.name: Referral-only
behaviours.how: All clients come from recommendations; has never paid for marketing and doubts a website brings clients.

behaviours.name: Has a cheap site already
behaviours.how: Paid 300-500 EUR for a WordPress site years ago; it is outdated but 'works'.

behaviours.name: Drowning in admin
behaviours.how: Spends evenings chasing clients for documents and answering unqualified requests; would pay to get hours back.

behaviours.name: Price-anchored locally
behaviours.how: Knows that sites in Oradea cost 400-900 EUR and compares every quote to that.

behaviours.name: Tech-curious
behaviours.how: Uses ChatGPT, follows AI news, likes to be first; but wants proof it works.

behaviours.name: Skeptical of newcomers
behaviours.how: Burned once by an agency that disappeared; asks for portfolio, references and who will answer the phone in a year.

objections: 2,400 EUR is a lot for a site plus two automations when my cousin's agency does sites for 500 EUR
I already get calls and newsletters about new funding calls for free; why would I pay for a radar?
A student with a day job: who maintains this when he has exams or gets a better job?
My clients send documents on WhatsApp; they will never use a portal link
AI pre-checking eligibility will get it wrong and embarrass me with a client
I don't need more leads; I need fewer bad ones and more hours
Show me one consultant in Romania who uses this and got results
140 EUR every month forever adds up; what do I actually get each month?
habits: you are closing two grant applications this week and the deadline is Friday
you drove to a farmer client 60 km away to collect a missing document
you just read in a newsletter that a guide was amended yesterday and nobody told you
you spent an hour on the phone with someone who was not eligible for anything
you are at a business conference in Oradea handing out business cards
your website still shows the 2019 funding programmes
